clues: This city and district sits in the metro area of Puebla, in Mexico. The big city of Puebla lies close by, in the same wide urban zone.
Rain falls most from May to October in this high land city. January is the coldest month of the year, and May is the warmest month.
Long ago, this small village grew step by step in the seventh century. In time it rose to be a main hub for the whole wide zone.
The city is split into eighteen small zones, each with its own patron saint. That split dates back to pre-Hispanic times, long ago.
A great pyramid stands in this city, with a famed church shrine on its top. It is the best known sight in the whole city by far.
